CheckTitle: Bedrock model invocation logging delivers prompt and response text.
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
Description: Bedrock model invocation logging is checked for text data delivery. A logging configuration can name a destination while excluding request and response bodies, so the destination alone does not establish that prompts and completions are captured.
Risk:
Invocation logging that excludes **text data** records that a call happened, but not what was sent or returned.

That leaves no evidence for the investigations which depend on content itself: **prompt injection**, data exfiltration, and abuse of the model by an authorized caller.

Recommendation.Text: Set textDataDeliveryEnabled to true on the model invocation logging configuration so prompt and response bodies are delivered to the configured destination.
